message: Android direct-download build 0.1.51 aligns media entry points with iOS: system album and file imports each accept mixed photos and videos in selection order, while originals are copied into App-private storage. This build also hardens the standards-based mixed-media picker fallback for manufacturer-specific Android implementations. Existing export, CasePackage, and resilient update improvements remain. 757 automated tests, full lint, signing and alignment checks, and retained-data mixed-media acceptance on Redmi passed. AppBao listing remains pending.
